title: AtlasClear Holdings to Present at the Emerging Growth Conference on May 7, 2026
summary: TAMPA, Fla., May 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - AtlasClear Holdings, Inc. (NYSE American: ATCH) (“AtlasClear” or the “Company”), a financial services company building clearing, custody, and trading infrastructure, has been invited to present at the Emerging Growth Conference being held virtually on May 7, 2026. AtlasClear’s management is scheduled to present on Thursday, May 7 at 2:35 p.m. Eastern Time. The 10-minute session will include a brief question-and-answer period. The presentation will be available via live webcast at: https://goto.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1755070tp_key=280dc3ffe3sti=atch AtlasClear welcomes individual and institutional investors, as well as advisors and analysts, to join its interactive presentation.
